info.title: Guardrails.Cli
info.description: Guardrails turns a reviewed markdown plan into an executable task DAG where every task carries deterministic acceptance checks ("guardrails"), and a cross-platform harness runs the DAG to green — retrying failed tasks with the failure evidence fed back to the agent, and halting honestly (needs-human) when a task cannot converge.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Guardrails — run a plan folder's task DAG to green.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate a plan folder without running it.

arguments.name: FOLDER
arguments.description: Path to the plan folder (contains guardrails.json). Defaults to the current directory when omitted.

commands.name: mark-reviewed
commands.description: Record that /guardrails-review ran over the current plan (writes the committed review marker).

arguments.name: FOLDER
arguments.description: Path to the plan folder (contains guardrails.json). Defaults to the current directory when omitted.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Run a plan folder's task DAG to green (parallel; resume-aware).

options.name: --fresh
options.description: Delete runtime state (run.json, state.json, logs) and re-seed before running. [default: False]

options.name: --no-ui
options.description: Plain line-by-line output instead of the live progress table. [default: False]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Validate and preview waves + per-task resolution + resume skips, then exit 0 without running or touching state. [default: False]

options.name: --no-log-server
options.description: Do not start the local log server / clickable per-task log links (for headless or CI use). [default: False]

options.name: --log-port
options.description: Port for the local log server (default 0 = an automatically chosen free port). Bound to localhost only.

options.name: --merge-on-success
options.description: On a wholly-green run, merge the plan branch into your original branch at run end (SSOT §5.3). Forces mergeOnSuccess on regardless of guardrails.json. [default: False]

options.name: --revalidate-task
options.description: Re-validate-only (issue #102): run ONLY this task's guardrails against the current workspace, spawning NO agent attempt — for confirming a hand-fix to a needs-human task. On pass the task is marked succeeded; serial mode only.

options.name: --skip-review-check
options.description: Suppress the warning when the plan hasn't been through /guardrails-review (or has changed since) (SSOT §13, issue #79). [default: False]

arguments.name: FOLDER
arguments.description: Path to the plan folder (contains guardrails.json). Defaults to the current directory when omitted.

commands.name: plan
commands.description: Show the execution waves for a plan folder (dry preview; runs nothing).

arguments.name: FOLDER
arguments.description: Path to the plan folder (contains guardrails.json). Defaults to the current directory when omitted.

commands.name: graph
commands.description: Render a Mermaid diagram of a plan folder's task/guardrail DAG.

options.name: --check
options.description: Report whether diagram.md (and diagram.html if present) are up to date (exit 0 fresh, 2 stale/missing, 1 on a load/validate error); writes nothing. A missing diagram.html is not stale — only a present-but-hash-mismatched one is. [default: False]

options.name: --stdout
options.description: Print the diagram to stdout instead of writing diagram.md (writes nothing to disk). [default: False]

options.name: --format
options.description: Diagram format. Only 'mermaid' is supported for now. [default: mermaid]

options.name: --no-html
options.description: Write only diagram.md; skip the interactive diagram.html navigation companion. Has no effect when combined with --stdout (which writes nothing to disk). [default: False]

arguments.name: FOLDER
arguments.description: Path to the plan folder (contains guardrails.json). Defaults to the current directory when omitted.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show per-task status from the run journal (read-only).

arguments.name: FOLDER
arguments.description: Path to the plan folder (contains guardrails.json). Defaults to the current directory when omitted.

commands.name: logs
commands.description: Serve the web log viewer over a plan's persisted logs (post-mortem; runs until Ctrl-C).

options.name: --port
options.description: Port for the log viewer (default 0 = an automatically chosen free port). Bound to localhost only.

options.name: --task
options.description: Open straight to this task's log page instead of the task list.

options.name: --no-open
options.description: Do not open a browser automatically; just print the URL. [default: False]

options.name: --export
options.description: Render a durable static HTML log site under logs/<runId>/ and exit (no server). Viewable after the run; --port/--task are ignored. [default: False]

arguments.name: FOLDER
arguments.description: Path to the plan folder (contains guardrails.json). Defaults to the current directory when omitted.

commands.name: reset
commands.description: Reset a task to pending, or wipe runtime state for a fresh run.

options.name: --yes
options.description: Skip the confirmation prompt for a full reset. [default: False]

arguments.name: FOLDER
arguments.description: Path to the plan folder (contains guardrails.json). Defaults to the current directory when omitted.

arguments.name: TASKID
arguments.description: Optional task id to reset to pending (omit for a full fresh reset).

commands.name: lock
commands.description: Record or compare a plan folder's breakdown manifest (guardrails.baseline).

options.name: --check
options.description: Report whether the folder matches guardrails.baseline (exit 0 clean, 2 drifted/missing, 1 corrupt); writes nothing. [default: False]

options.name: --diff
options.description: Print the per-file classification (edited/added/missing) against guardrails.baseline; writes nothing. [default: False]

arguments.name: FOLDER
arguments.description: Path to the plan folder (contains guardrails.json). Defaults to the current directory when omitted.

commands.name: merge
commands.description: Merge a freshly regenerated breakdown into the current folder, preserving human guardrail edits.

options.name: --remote
options.description: Path to the freshly generated candidate breakdown (REMOTE) to merge in.

options.name: --apply
options.description: Apply the merge in place and re-lock (only when there are no conflicts); otherwise dry-run report. [default: False]

arguments.name: FOLDER
arguments.description: Path to the plan folder (contains guardrails.json). Defaults to the current directory when omitted.

commands.name: skills
commands.description: Manage the Guardrails Claude Code skills bundled with this tool.

commands.name: install
commands.description: Install the bundled skills into Claude Code's skills directory.

options.name: --target
options.description: Explicit directory to install the skills into (overrides the default and --project).

options.name: --project
options.description: Install into ./.claude/skills in the current directory (created if missing) instead of the user home. [default: False]

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite a skill folder that already exists in the target — required to refresh an installed skill (and remove any stale version sidecar), otherwise it is skipped. `guardrails --version` warns about skipped/stale skills. [default: False]
